We can't say. The evidence tool made no observation for this asset (ASSET-J), because the satellite data coverage it needs hasn't been prepared. None of the sources it would use (Hansen Global Forest Change, JRC GFC2020, MGAP 2021) were available for this asset, so the 2021–2025 check over the whole boundary couldn't be run.

This result does not show that tree cover was kept, and it does not show that it was lost. It also supports no regulatory conclusion, such as EUDR compliant, non-compliant or deforestation-free.

To answer your question, the missing source coverage would have to be prepared for this asset and the assessment re-run. The evidence reflects what was known as of 2026-11-12.
